mentions.name: Fable Flops
mentions.description: A storytelling/creativity card game. Its design is iterating on a core mechanic to make the game more fun, and it is open for playtesting by anyone who has Tabletop Simulator.
mentions.source_excerpt: A storytelling/creativity card game. I was struggling for a bit to figure out a mechanic that could make it more fun and I think I am finally making some good progress. If anyone has tabletop simulator and wants to help test, hit me up.
